flags.headline: AEM — new RED: Barnat pit wall movement suspends mining at Canadian Malartic, 60-80koz H2 guidance cut
flags.detail: A rock-mass movement occurred 2026-07-01 along the north wall of the Barnat open pit at Canadian Malartic, Quebec. No injuries, no equipment damage, no environmental impact, but mining at the Barnat pit was suspended as a precaution; the area had previously been flagged for weaker geology under enhanced geotechnical monitoring. Agnico Eagle expects H2 2026 Canadian Malartic production reduced by ~60,000-80,000 oz gold, pushing FY2026 guidance toward the low end of the 3.3-3.5M oz range, with a possible ~150,000 oz/year reduction flagged for 2027-2028 pending assessment. Updated guidance will be confirmed with Q2 2026 results on 2026-07-29. Today's price move is muted (-0.66%) — the market may not have fully digested the guidance-cut magnitude yet.
flags.thesis_link: Touches AEM key_risk #3: 'any execution miss on the 4M+ oz production target... could trigger meaningful valuation compression.' This is precisely that execution miss materializing, distinct from the already-tracked gold-price key_risk #1.

flags.headline: GPC +12.91% — informational: Bloomberg reports O'Reilly bid for NAPA auto-parts unit, ~$10B
flags.detail: Genuine Parts jumped 12.91% (price $132.57 vs prior close $117.41) after Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that O'Reilly Automotive has made a cash bid for GPC's NAPA auto-parts unit potentially valued at $10B+. This is consistent with GPC's previously announced plan to split into two public companies; a decision could come by end of summer, and GPC could also retain or spin off the unit without O'Reilly. No 8-K filed yet — unconfirmed/rumor-stage M&A, so there is reversal risk if the report is denied or the deal falls through.
flags.thesis_link: Directly relevant to GPC key_risk #1 ('business separation execution risk') — a real buyer for NAPA would be a path to resolving that risk, not a new threat, hence informational rather than a flag needing action.
